title: OpenCues blank.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a blank.md file. Spec: opencues/0.1-alpha. See /spec/blank-spec.md.

oneOf.description: impl: implicit from name — name resolves to <PascalCase(name)>Blank in the runtime. Other runtimes MAY treat as unsupported.

name.description: Unique identifier. Implicit class name when impl: is omitted.

description.description: Human-readable summary. Validators warn when absent.

blankKeywords.description: Words that fire this blank when one leads the sentence containing _ (sentence-scoped: the segment after the last sentence terminator or newline before _). Desugar into anchored blankShapes.

type.description: Discriminator. Required — the reference parser dispatches purely on this field; a BLANK.md omitting it is never converted into a blank, regardless of folder location.

blankShapes.description: Anchored regex grammar routing a _ deterministically. Each shape is matched against the sentence containing _ (the segment after the last sentence terminator or newline before _). When omitted, synthesized from blankKeywords (+ blankStep).

valueGroup.description: 1-based capture group carrying the set/step value.

blankStep.description: Increment size for numeric blanks; also synthesizes set/step shapes from keywords.

integration.description: Additive output template with a {value} slot, e.g. 'volume is now {value}'. Shapes the inserted value only.

as-context.description: Opt-in for blank-as-context: exposes the blank's current value as an ambient sentinel token (e.g. [STOCKS], [WEATHER]) the LLM can reference without the user typing the keyword. Shares the catalog machinery defined in identity-context-spec.md. See blank-spec.md § Sentinel aspects.

contextTtl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds for the blank-as-context snapshot before the runtime re-invokes get() on prompt-build. Only meaningful when as-context is safe or raw.

blankClearKeywords.description: After a non-shaped fill, strip the blank's own keyword from the resulting text.

blankScript.description: Binding profile — relative path to a shell script.

speak.description: Per-blank TTS hint. Reserved; TTS itself is non-standard.
